summary: Describes how to carry IP datagrams, and the higher-level protocols above them, over Network Systems Corporation's HYPERchannel equipment. It targets network planners and implementors who already know TCP/IP, and includes an appendix reviewing HYPERchannel technology. It was an Internet standard and was later updated by RFC 5494.

eli5.summary: A special fast cable system for big computers had its own rules. This memo explains how to put regular Internet packets on it.

questions: how to run ip over hyperchannel
